decisions.statement: An id no buy rule has refuses the call.
The id is said as a word and the answer's shape at its flag.
A call saying no id is refused, asking for the id by its placeholder.
A flag this takes none of is refused, naming both the ways this is said.
The answer's shape carries no value, so a value joined to it is refused.
The answer's shape said twice is refused rather than read once.

definition: the command giving back one buy rule named by its id
